notes.author: ted
notes.text: Met Jordan and Hannah at the welcome center on their first Sunday. They married last year and are looking for a church to grow in together. Sent the newcomers email and the Starting Point dates.
notes.testPurpose: A follow-up on a new couple's first visit.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Hannah called to ask how to set up online giving for the two of them. Walked her through the giving page, and Jordan set up a gift every other week while we were on the phone.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Hannah mentioned that she teaches second grade and would love to help in kids ministry once they feel settled. No rush on our end.

replies.author: ted
replies.text: I'll make sure she hears about the next kids team orientation.
